items.unit: INR per machine (company turnover / machines sold, derived)
items.basis: Windsor Machines (listed Indian maker of injection moulding machines AND pipe / blown-film extrusion lines) FY2023-24 directors' report: 'sold 382 machines to achieve turnover of 337.22 crores' (FY2022-23: 404 machines, Rs 347.01 cr). Rs 337.22 cr / 382 = Rs 88.3 lakh per machine (FY23: 347.01 / 404 = Rs 85.9 lakh). Revenue is ex-GST but includes spares / service.
items.scope: MIX of injection moulding machines of all tonnages AND extrusion lines (blown film / pipe), which are larger-ticket items; not a 200 / 500 / 1200 t price
items.notes: Read from the search-result summary (page not fetched; proxy blocks). MarketScreener gives an injection moulding SEGMENT revenue (Rs 167.67 / 211.37 / 228.42 / 203.27 / 190.93 cr, reported as FY21-FY25) but no IMM-only unit count, so an IMM-only average cannot be derived. Use as an upper-side order of magnitude for a mid-size Indian-made IMM only.

items.basis: Shibaura Machine India (Chennai, injection moulding machines): turnover Rs 500 cr 'last fiscal year' (report c. mid-2024, i.e. FY2023-24) and capacity 1,200 machines/yr before Unit 2 (raised to 4,000). Units sold <= capacity, so revenue per machine >= Rs 500 cr / 1,200 = Rs 41.7 lakh.
items.kind: company disclosure (revenue / capacity — a bound, not an average)
items.scope: MIX of tonnages; turnover includes spares / service
items.notes: Read from the search result; page not fetched. Bound only. Actual units sold not found.
